title: Adrenaline Buzz
text:
We booked via email after seeing information on Google maps. We paid a 30% deposit and the balance when we arrived. They accept card or cash at the site. They also have some drinks for sale, and toilets!
We were collected and dropped back to our hotel. 
My 16 year old stepson always wanted to have a go, and this company allows 16 year old to ride solo. He loved it! It was through rugged mountain terrain, up hills, through trees, down steep slopes - not for the faint hearted! title: A must do!
text: Outstanding, a must do! Picked up from hotel in mini bus taken to place it was unreal. Right up in the hills with plenty of opportunity for photos, guide was fantastic would 100% recommend. My first stop next time I visit this area
